Allowed endpoint host from the source. Maps to ObjectObservation.ServerHostname on this connection. Do not merge connection identities by host or infer a shared cross-platform data source.
Source database or provider-specific database identifier. Maps to ObjectObservation.DatabaseName on this connection. Shared data-source records and cross-platform endpoint matching are deferred.
Tableau native authentication method when present. Maps to ObjectObservation.AuthenticationTypeCode. Preserve the source code for mapping review. Missing does not imply anonymous access.

Optional verified connection credential classification. Current query profiles establish only Unknown. Do not infer a service or personal account from a hostname, username, or authentication method. Unknown establishes no credential compliance conclusion.

Evidence for captured connection facts. Maps to ObjectObservation.EvidenceStatusCode. This projection reports Partial while credential controls remain unverified. Dataset coverage separately controls what absences can mean.
